newsitem.title: UK: UK's Taylor Nelson buys Denmark's Gallup.
newsitem.headline: UK's Taylor Nelson buys Denmark's Gallup.

text.p: British market research company Taylor Nelson AGB Plc said on Wednesday it had bought Danish media research company Gallup A/S for an initial 4.8 million stg.
Taylor Nelson said it would pay 3.0 million stg cash and issue shares with a current market value of 1.8 million stg.
A further payment of Taylor Nelson shares worth up to 1.2 million stg could be paid if Gallup A/S met agreed performance targets, the company said.
Taylor Nelson said Gallup A/S was Denmark's leading media research group, established for over 55 years.
It said turnover at the Danish group totalled around 6.3 million stg last year and net profit was around 533,000 stg.

Gallup A/S is part of the Gallup International Association, a grouping of market researchers across the world. It is not related to U.S. opinion pollsters Gallup Inc., a spokeswoman for Taylor Nelson said.
